mapper.sql: m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.order_num, m.path, m.component, m.menu_type, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon, m.group_name, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.remark, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = '0' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms <> '' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = '0' AND ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT
FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.status = '0' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = '0' AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.status = '0' ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
